November 8, 2018
I-76 / State Hwy 52 Hudson Interchange Project
• Develop solutions to address interchange deficiencies. Safety/Mobility
• Establish a corridor that safely moves vehicles, pedestrians and trucks through Hudson.
• Increase efficient, well-defined movement of vehicles through the Town.
• Restrict unauthorized parking on SH 52. Traffic
• Address the increased volume of heavy vehicles at the interchange, as well as along SH 52, due to development (including Love’s Truck Stop).
• Project implementation will be phased based upon funding and deficiency priority.
